description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator class which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items for the Performance module within OrangeHRM's HRM system. It overrides the current screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker'.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu items for the Performance Tracker section, overriding the current screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker' and returns null.
